info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Logistics Shipments Exceptions-v4-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipments Exceptions API provides businesses with vital insights into exceptions that occur during the logistics shipment process. By querying this endpoint, users can access a comprehensive list of shipment exceptions, enabling them to understand operational bottlenecks and improve their logistics management. Common consumers of this API include supply chain managers and logistics coordinators, who rely on this information to address issues promptly and enhance shipment reliability. This API serves as a critical tool in optimizing overall logistics performance.

get.description: Fetch a list of shipments that have encountered exceptions during processing. This endpoint allows for the identification and review of problematic shipments.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve instances of shipment exceptions. It is expected to follow the defined schema for proper formatting and required fields.

200.description: Request completed successfully; returns shipment exception details.
